cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll agree to equal cake portions if mine accounts for the baking time.

mechanism: A treats fairness as a ruling A controls, admitting only interpretations that protect A head start or larger share.
confusable: Distinguish merely asking for more from conceding equality only after redefining its calculation or geometry.
comparison: Race timing uses physical rule reinterpretation; cake allocation uses labor accounting and exclusion of prior consumption.
seedUse: Canonical race and cake seeds already let A dictate fairness; read S01 supervisory seeds as method, not as mandatory approval wording.
